svg.title: X8 - Molex HSAutoLink II 12-circuit right-angle header, key option B - mating face wireframe
svg.desc: Front (mating-face) view of the Molex HSAutoLink II 12-circuit right-angle unsealed header (series 34861), key option B. Geometry is the Molex drawing front view for key option B; dimensions are Molex sheet 2 values.
svg.text: X8 — Molex HSAutoLink II 12-circuit R/A header · key option B
Mating-face (front) view · A11 Radio (IOK) USB · Molex series 34861 (34861-1116 / -1316), sheets 1-2 · geometry and dimensions from the Molex drawing
Top-centre key tab below the housing top
Pins 1-6: top row, left to right (1.27 mm pitch).
Pins 7-12: bottom row, left to right, staggered
0.635 mm to the left of the top row.
Number sits to the right of its contact.
Pin assignment — X8 (IOK), as wired by GM
0 V, not tied to GND (function unknown)
0 V, not tied to GND (function unknown)
0 V, not tied to GND (function unknown)
Pin functions supplied by the design owner (as wired
by GM for the IOK radio); pins 2, 4, 5, 11, 12 read
0 V but are not tied to GND. Pins 7-10 terminate as
a Mini-B USB connector on the HSAL-2 cable. The GM
manual itself gives no per-pin map for X8. Harness:
Instrument Panel Wiring Harness USB; OEM connector
Header data — from the Molex drawing
holes; key option B moves the right hold-down hole to
Housing SPS 30% GF · terminals Cu alloy, selective

Source: Molex series 34861 drawing — sheet 1 front view for key option B (geometry, redrawn in black on white) and sheet 2 (dimensions 18.20, 12.49, 14.40, 9.15, 1.29, 2.80 and balloons 2-7). Sheet 2 is
drawn for key option A; the body outline is common, and the dimension lines here were placed on the option-B geometry at the same features (measured spans agree with the Molex values).
Contact centres were measured on the drawing: 1.27 mm pitch, 0.635 mm row stagger, row separation ≈1.6 mm — not dimensioned by Molex. Key option B was specified by the design owner.
Note: Molex lists option B as gray (34861-1116/-1316), while the GM manual describes the X8 harness connector as BK. Verify the colour/key against the physical part.
